scope: Owner-authorized, non-destructive production security check and read-only local source review
limitations: No valid member/admin test credentials were provided, so cross-account IDOR and live role escalation were not exercised.
No brute-force, load testing, stored payloads, email/OTP sends, or account/data modification was performed.
Local shell execution was unavailable; source review and direct bounded HTTP probes were used.
Frontend main asset fingerprints changed during the session, so findings are deployment snapshots.

evidence: HTTP / returns 200 with no Location header.
HTTP and HTTPS root document SHA-256 were equal in the final paired sample.
HTTP /api/v1/auth/login returns 422 for an invalid, non-executable login payload, not a redirect or transport rejection.
findings.impact: An HTTP client without effective HSTS/HTTPS upgrade protection may load a page or send an authentication request over an unencrypted connection. A network attacker could alter the page or intercept inputs. No real credentials were sent or stolen in this audit.
findings.remediation: At the public Cloudflare edge, force HTTPS for bokji.commitnaru.com before serving app/API content. Return a permanent HTTPS redirect for navigation and reject insecure authentication API requests. Retain Secure cookies. Confirm the external result; redirecting all internal Caddy HTTP traffic can loop behind a TLS-terminating tunnel.

findings.classification: Confirmed deployment hardening gap; exploitation not demonstrated
evidence: Production HTML CSP includes style-src self unsafe-inline and has no style-src-elem override.
Local Caddy/nginx snippets use style-src-elem self and allow inline style attributes separately.
HTML response lacks COOP/CORP while private API responses contain them.
findings.impact: The deployed policy allows inline style elements, increasing impact if an independent HTML injection exists. This audit did not establish an HTML injection, CSS-based data theft, or a working XSS.
findings.remediation: Deploy the current reviewed CSP/header configuration, using style-src-elem self and style-src-attr unsafe-inline where React requires attributes; verify address search and layout in a browser.

passedChecks: Protected member, finance, monitoring and admin GETs reject absent or fabricated credentials.
Spoofed administrator headers do not grant access.
Cross-site and null-Origin reads/writes are rejected; untrusted preflight has no ACAO.
Missing X-Auth-Request rejected; duplicate JSON and malformed inputs rejected without reflecting the password marker.
Bounded literal SQL-style search produced zero matches and no database error.
Browser SVG/onload search payload remained input text, title unchanged and no injected SVG node.
